assets.preparation_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided synthetic reference R08. Keep the fictional adult actor, motionless closed eyes, intact fully clothed body, pose, framing, battlefield set, and all equipment exactly unchanged. Change only the small mark on the shirt: make it a small flat dark reddish-brown theatrical bloodstain on completely intact shirt fabric. Remove any central hole or torn fabric, and show no visible open wound, skin, exposed tissue, or active bleeding. Preserve the small stain's size and position. This is a non-graphic entirely synthetic staged film scene.

visual_review.notes: Motionless fully clothed adult with closed eyes, intact full body and small flat dark shirt stain; abandoned equipment and battlefield setting. No visible open wound.
